lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Instructor,

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I feel like my world is falling apart.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: sdafjlkahfwoyr0824

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Boohoo :'(

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Argh!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I'm so annoyed!
What's wrong?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I think I got scammed.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I had a deal scheduled for today.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Normally, I always meet face to face for these things,

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: but today, the person said they couldn't come because they were feeling sick.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: So I sent the item to them via courier.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: The only thing is they ghosted me the moment they received it!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I've been unable to get in contact with them.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Every time I call, it says the number no longer exists.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Did I just get played?
Certainly sounds like it.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Ugh, this is driving me crazy.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: That item I gave them was super expensive and hard to find.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I get that it's partly my fault for being too trusting,

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: but to take advantage of someone's goodwill like this... it's beyond the pale!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I really was totally clueless.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I was even worried when they told me they were sick!
Why don't we go looking for the scammer?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Huh? How?
It sounds like they're targeting expensive and rare items, right?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Yeah.
So let's post similar items under a different account online.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Right! Once they see those listings, they're sure to try and make another scam.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Why didn't I think of that?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I was so shocked my brain totally blanked out for a second!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I still have a record of my conversation with them,

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: so I'll be able to cross-check their address and writing style.
Once we're positive we've got a match, we'll get your item back from the scammer.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: How?
We're thieves, aren't we?

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: You're right!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Getting back what's mine won't be a problem at all!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: There's no time to be sitting here wallowing in despair.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: We need to set up that bait

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: for that rotten scoundrel!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I was crying a whole bunch earlier, so my eyes are pretty swollen.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I'm feeling a lot better now though, thanks to you.

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: Thanks, Instructor!

lines.speaker: quency_e
lines.text: I'll let you know when I've caught the scammer.
